notes.title: Primal Fray: Prologue Releasement Diary ৻( •̀ ᗜ •́ ৻)
notes.notes:
DevDiary - Prologue is almost ready for you ৻(  •̀ ᗜ •́  ৻)

We are happy to announce that you can soon experience the first fresh breeze of our new game [b]Primal Fray : Prologue[/b]◝(ᵔᵕᵔ)◜

Let me quickly explain what you can expect in the prologue version of [b]Primal Fray[/b]!

As soon as you enter the Rift, you start your journey as [b]Glacier[/b], an ice tank who can shield your allies and himself. With him you can easily start eliminating your enemies (˶ᵔ ᵕ ᵔ˶)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/97759740c91605a24d2cb1695441e7e79716f8ab.gif[/img]


After your first battle, you can choose from [b]20 different primals[/b], boons and upgrades. But don’t worry, there will be even more primals in the final version ♡
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/4f041d8f7344b96a7d807444e52008019af29057.gif[/img]

Build your powerful team with different characters, or pick a lot of Glacier’s like me instead! I really like him •ᴗ•
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/3966d44635dc73f94f648c1a9183ab37b8dd9b40.gif[/img]

As the final boss for Prologue, meet mighty [b]Hortensius[/b], who will surprise you with his powerful attacks ⊹ 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/9eadac26324720fca6d5c9f6d0774d6b3c705fa6.gif[/img]

You can easily check enemies stats by right clicking on them! Very helpful to get to know them ᡣ𐭩
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/d8a17cc39678b08677acff109238895688a4811b.gif[/img]

Be careful of [b]Hortensius special attack[/b], as he spawns and buffs his minions in the combat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45464351/78241e29fe197b2fd0f2727c59ed3d0144d6bd43.gif[/img]

That’s all I wanted to share with you today. Stay tuned for more Primal Fray: Prologue updates ٩(ˊᗜˋ*)و ♡

With love ᰔᩚ
Świrek, Sana, Doktorek
